To whom should I speak and testify, that they may hear? Behold, their ear is uncircumcised, and they can’t listen.…
For as often as I speak, I cry out; I cry, “Violence and destruction!” because Yahweh’s word has been made a reproach…
Then Amaziah the priest of Bethel sent to Jeroboam king of Israel, saying, “Amos has conspired against you in the…
The world can’t hate you, but it hates me, because I testify about it, that its works are evil.
Have any of the rulers believed in him, or of the Pharisees?
Those of the Pharisees who were with him heard these things, and said to him, “Are we also blind?”

translations.web: One of the lawyers answered him, “Teacher, in saying this you insult us also.”
translations.bsb: One of the experts in the law told Him, “Teacher, when You say these things, You insult us as well.”
translations.kjv: Then answered one of the lawyers, and said unto him, Master, thus saying thou reproachest us also.
translations.asv: And one of the lawyers answering saith unto him, Teacher, in saying this thou reproachest us also.
